property.text: One sweep catches each planted ordering control of depth 1 to 3 beside cluster-broad at least once in at least 1,000 of its runs that ended caught, missed or with no effect, and misses none of its runs: each caught run ends in the cluster checker's violation "a GET returned bytes no upload of its key wrote", of the obligation Bytes, and the receipt reports for each control the caught runs over its runs with a one-sided 95% lower bound.

threshold.measured: the status document of one sweep of ks-ordering-figure: for each of cluster-order-1, cluster-order-2 and cluster-order-3, its runs, caught, missed, the runs counted under uncredited "unsuccessful: the control's plant took no effect" and the runs counted under its other uncredited endings, such as "inconclusive: limit same_time"

invariants.oracle: The cluster checker of the simulation harness (crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests/cluster.rs, a cfg(test) tree), which judges each complete read's bytes against the uploads of its key apart from the cache's own code. Each ordering plant changes the last byte of one read of the hot key's version 0 only when its premise of d session-event orders holds (crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests/cluster/order.rs), and the sweep counts the run under caught when the checker raises the rule, under missed when the plant acted and no check failed, under the no-effect ending when the premise never formed, and under an inconclusive ending when the run stopped at a limit of the simulator or the recorder.

witness.check: a valid run of ks-ordering-figure in which each of the three controls has at least 1,000 runs that ended caught, missed or with no effect, a replay, no suspect and a catch under the row's rule at every depth

control.how: the same sweep on a scratch archive built from a tree whose crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests/cluster/order.rs has the one line `Plant::Depth1 => true,` of Order::decided changed to `Plant::Depth1 => false,`, so the depth-1 plant selects no read whatever order the session events take, and cluster-order-1 is caught in no run: each of its runs ends with no effect or at a limit; the change is never pushed, the run's label begins with the name of the control the build leaves uncaught, and the figure judge reports cluster-order-1 not found in its runs
control.expect: a GET returned bytes no upload of its key wrote

scenarios.text: One sweep of the scripted history h1-get-stale, which declares its violation, at default counts, runs 28 workers in batches of 30 s for 120 s on a new root.

load.reference: h1-get-stale; no production figure applies: a sweep runs seeds in virtual time at the rate the worker's cores allow, so its load is a count of runs and not a rate of requests

scenarios.restoration: Each run sweeps a new root under its own campaign name with the archive the harness is given. The harness records in run.json left_a_process 0 and archive_verified true, and the validity judge requires both.
stop_conditions: the campaign process passes the run deadline deadline_s
the sweep is killed or receives SIGINT or SIGTERM
